package com.larryfarming.farming.engine; /** * Whether a farming run is worth doing right now. * *

"Not now" splits three ways because each draws differently: waiting (count down), * locked (grey, naming what is missing or what blocks the way), and unseen (admit we * cannot tell). */ public enum RunStatus { /** * Something at one of the stops wants attention: a crop finished growing, a patch * caught disease or died, or a patch is standing empty. * *

An empty patch counts on purpose. A player who has never planted hardwood trees * has nothing growing to wait for, and a scheduler that only watched timers would * stay silent about the most valuable run in the game. */ DUE, /** Everything is growing. There is a time to count down to. */ PENDING, /** * Nothing the player does today on the run itself helps, so it is never due. Either the * run is not unlocked yet, or no stop on the route proper has a route this player can * take: every one a definite refusal, such as a run only fairy rings reach with every * way to a ring switched off. The detail names what is missing or what blocks the way. * *

Routes are judged on the variant {@link RunVariants} chose, the one the walkthrough * shows. A route resting on something unread (an unseen bank, a house whose town is * unknown) is a guess, and a guess leaves the run as it is. */ LOCKED, /** * Not one of this run's patches has ever been observed, so there is nothing to * predict from. * *

Patch varbits only transmit while the player is standing in the patch's region, * so a fresh install knows nothing about anything planted before it. The first walk * past any patch settles it. */ UNSEEN }
